api23_regex: No (?U)/UNICODE_CHARACTER_CLASS usage. Unicode-aware shorthands expand to explicit ICU-compatible properties; frozen sacremoses English membership classes used. Toolkit regex-module word semantics tested including superscript exclusion, combining marks, Roman numerals, connectors.
bounds: 8192 source chars,128 distinct entities,65536 decoded/restored outputchars; reserved sourceplaceholders rejected; maps are request-local.
limitations: No Android runtime execution established by these standalone JVM tests.
This deterministic processor does not translate languages or establish model/clinical accuracy.
Entity serial order uses deterministic first-occurrence iteration instead of Python set ordering; each request carries its own mapping.
Official digit-table asymmetries and the reviewed detokenizer sequence are preserved.
